name: Ayase Sayuki
source:
Sayuki is the oldest member of the group and is the head of the book club at school. She acts like a big sister to everyone else, especially Yua. She is well-known around the school. Sayuki also has a secret crush on Tomoki and seems to know [url=/c2280]Yua[/url] from somewhere….

[Taken from [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/12/14/your-diary-review/]Liemyx's review[/url].]
